title: Frisky Mermaid Dolphin Cruises & Pontoon Boat Rentals
specs: Dolphins spotted on nearly every cruise in Santa Rosa Sound and Pensacola Bay
Snorkel tours in calm, shallow waters with colorful fish, crabs, rays, and sea creatures
Explore Sand Island, Fort Pickens, Fort McRee, and secluded beaches only accessible by boat
Every passenger requires a ticket including infants
Minimum age 25 and boater safety certificate required to rent pontoon boats if born after 12/31/1987
Basic swimming skills required for snorkel tours
Passengers must be physically able to climb stairs to board dolphin cruise boats
Maximum weight limit 225 lbs for snorkel participation
Dolphin cruise boat maximum 49 passengers; Salty Dolphin boat max 41 passengers; both available for private rental
Pontoon boats accommodate up to 10 passengers including captain

blurb: Guests can join dolphin cruises on the Santa Rosa Sound and Pensacola Bay to see bottlenose dolphins, take guided snorkel tours in shallow waters, visit secluded beaches only accessible by boat, and rent pontoon boats for multi-day exploration of the Emerald Coast. The dolphin cruises run 1.5 to 2 hours with live narration and are family-friendly. Pontoon rentals accommodate up to 10 passengers and include safety instruction and equipment.
